Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 28

“Arjuna said: O Krishna, seeing these my own people standing here, eager for battle...”

The sentence breaks off mid-thought, and that is the point — Arjuna cannot finish it. What he sees before him is not an enemy army but a family reunion armed for slaughter.
